slides.visual: Aachu stands near the home doorway dressed casually to go out, holding keys and sandals, looking hopeful toward Zuv in the room.
Zuv is half-buried under a blanket on the bed or sofa, phone on chest, one sock half-off, clearly low-battery and homesick.
Aachu places his sneakers near the bed; Zuv peeks from the blanket and raises one hand in a tiny bargaining gesture.

slides.story_job: The full plan shrinks into the tiny compromise.
slides.visual: Door half open, outside light coming in; Aachu waits by the door while Zuv sits up with blanket still around his shoulders.

slides.story_job: Physical proof beat and funniest middle.
slides.visual: Zuv appears at the doorway with one sneaker on and one home slipper still on, messy hair, casual hoodie over sleep clothes; Aachu notices and starts laughing.
They sit on building stairs or a tiny gate-side bench; Aachu has outside air, Zuv still has almost-home posture, shoes and slippers visible.
They sit close on the stairs or bench, she leans happy into him, he still looks sleepy but satisfied; open building door behind them.
